title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Government Debt & Infrastructure Finance - Paraguay

description.narrative: The GDIF Resident Advisor will provide technical assistance to Hacienda officials who have responsibility for public debt issuance and management, and to coordinate these efforts with Banco Central del Paraguay (BCP) officials as needed.
